A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".
Program:
```python
go_home()
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1 and abs(c["height"] - pen["height"]) < 0.005:
        best_candidate = c
        break
if best_candidate is None:
    best_candidate = candidates[0]

grasp_result = grasp(best_candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
if not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot found in green_case")

target_spot = None
for spot in spots["spots"]:
    if abs(abs(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - case["long_axis_yaw"]) - 0) < 0.1:
        target_spot = spot
        break
if target_spot is None:
    target_spot = spots["spots"][0]

carry_to(target_spot["x"], target_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
```
